tools.description: Search public clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, treatment or sponsor, optionally narrowed by place (city, state, country, or a ZIP code with a radius), status, phase, sex or age. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_trial_eligibility" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
